about: Every operator string on the ingest surfaces, read by hand against the writing canon and the plain-speech law (CLAUDE.md; scoreboard rows A12.1, A12.10, A12.12): imperative mood with no noun-forms, no property-talk about history, no invented slang, constructed phrasing or reassurance flourish. tests/ingest-faces.test.ts holds the register to the code: a string the code spells that is not here fails the chain until it is read and added, and a string here that the code no longer spells is removed. Templates carry X where a value goes. The scope is the sweep's own file list without the three prompt modules a model reads (src/lib/activity/run.ts, src/app/intranet/runners.ts, src/lib/ingest/verdict-reason.ts), plus the Drop's handlers in src/app/room/room-client.tsx. Opened by pass 15, 2026-10-09.
